blocks.tamil_translation: Mu'adh (RA) sitting near the blessed grave of the Prophet ﷺ and weeping, and asked, “Why are you weeping? He said, “I am weeping because of something I heard from Rasulullah ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Even a little love of self-praise is part of associating partners (Shirk). Whoever bears enmity towards a friend of Allah Ta'ala has called Allah Ta'ala to war. Allah Ta'ala surely loves the people who are righteous and God-fearing, who are not searched for when they are absent from the town, and who are neither invited nor recognised when they are present in the town; their hearts are lamps of guidance. (Protecting their Din by the light of their hearts) they will come out of the dark dust storms of trials (Fitnah).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا ذِئْبَانِ جَائِعَانِ اُرْسِلَا فِيْ غَنَمٍ بِأَفْسَدَ لَهَا مِنْ حِرْصِ الْمَرْءِ عَلَي الْمَالِ وَالشَّرَفِ لِدِيْنِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح، باب حديث ما ذئبان جائعان ارسلا في غنم...، رقم:٢٣٧٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Greed for wealth and greed for position do greater harm to a person's Din than the harm two hungry wolves let loose in a flock of goats do to the goats.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ طَلَبَ الدُّنْيَا حَلَالاً مُفَاخِرًا مُكَاثِرًا مُرَائِيًّا لَقِيَ اللهَ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ، وَمَنْ طَلَبَ الدُّنْيَا حَلَالاً اِسْتِعْفَافًا عَنِ الْمَسْئَلَةِ وَسَعْيًا عَلَي عِيَالِهِ وَتَعَطُّفًا عَلي جَارِهِ لَقِيَ اللهَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَوَجْهُهُ كَالْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a person earns wealth with the intention of gaining pride, becoming rich, and gaining name and fame, even if he earns it in a halal way
